source.text: Patients with refractory or recurrent non-central nervous system (CNS) solid tumors not amenable to curative treatment are eligible.
Patients with refractory or recurrent Ewing sarcoma (during or after completion of first-line therapy).
Patients must have either measurable or evaluable disease (see Section 7.0 for definitions).
Performance level: Karnofsky \> 50% for patients \> 16 years of age and Lansky \> 50% for patients \< 16 years of age.
Pregnant or breast-feeding women will not be entered on this study.
